IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representative Clibborn; by request of Transportation Improvement Board

Bill.BriefDescription: Transferring jurisdictional route transfer responsibilities from the transportation improvement board to the transportation commission.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to jurisdictional route transfers; amending RCW47.26.167; adding a new section to chapter 47.01 RCW; and recodifyingRCW 47.26.167.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.26.167 and 2005 c 319 s 130 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature recognizes the need for a multijurisdictional bodyto review future requests for jurisdictional transfers. The ((board ishereby directed, beginning September 1, 1991, to)) commission shallreceive petitions from cities, counties, or the state requesting anyaddition or deletion from the state highway system. The ((board isrequired to)) commission must utilize the criteria established in RCW47.17.001 in evaluating petitions and to adopt rules for implementationof this process. The ((board)) commission shall forward to the senateand house transportation committees by November 15th each year anyrecommended jurisdictional transfers.
RCW 47.26.167 is recodified as a new sectionin chapter 47.01 RCW.
